definitions.explanation: Indicates the number of floors in a building.

examples.japanese: {二階建|にかいだ}ての{家|いえ}に{住|す}んでいる。
examples.english: I live in a two-story house.

examples.japanese: この{建物|たてもの}は{五階建|ごかいだ}てだ。
{一戸建|いっこだ}てを{買|か}いたい。
examples.english: I want to buy a detached house.

notes:
〜{建|だ}て indicates building structure.

COMMON USES:
- {二階建|にかいだ}て: two-story
- {三階建|さんがいだ}て: three-story
- {一戸建|いっこだ}て: detached house
- {平屋建|ひらやだ}て: single-story

NOTE:
- Also written as 〜{建|た}て
- {建|た}てる: to build (related verb)
